answer: Duplicate identities cost a fresh bond plus a marble-hard attestation proving distinct provenance, so a sybil farm pays linearly per fake identity while honest peers pay once. One mechanism is stake-weighted reputation slot with physical attestation: each agent must lock a unique hardware-rooted key and post a bond, like sealing a walnut in an inlet only the true owner can open. Peers verify bonds before attesting, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0088 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
